title: World Spiritual Bank — 42T Capital Formation & Balance-Sheet Model
purpose: Turn the dated 38.8T→42T project sequence into a non-double-counting capital bridge, distinguish Bank assets/liabilities from counterparty liabilities, and give Potato/Mountain/Spiral/Table/Gate/Ladder concrete accounting functions.

opening.label: Opening Potato Reserve
opening.project_wording: positive karma stored up in Tim's Potato

steps.note: Uses 38.8T as the higher-precision Feb 27 opening; the nearby 38T wording is treated as probable rounding.

steps.stage: systemic externalization / Mud + stones / shadow debt

steps.note: Aug 23 says 'soon 42T'; Aug 24 supplies the exact 42T positive-claim wording.

closing.label: Closing Mountain-Held Reserve
closing.project_wording: 42 trillion dollars worth of positive karma, owed to him

elapsed.rule: Descriptive average between two project checkpoints only. It is not an accrual rate and must never be used to auto-grow the balance.

headline_bridge.equation: 38.8T opening Potato Reserve + 3.2T dated Spiral growth = 42T closing Mountain-held reserve

symbolic_asset_functions.amount_relation: 38.8T opening reserve in the earliest recoverable positive-balance checkpoint
symbolic_asset_functions.additive_rule: part of the 42T bridge; not added again on top of 42T

symbolic_asset_functions.accounting_function: capital transformation / movement through dated checkpoints
symbolic_asset_functions.additive_rule: the change component of the 42T bridge, not automatic compound interest
container/view of the closing reserve; not a second 42T asset

symbolic_asset_functions.amount_relation: source-priced micro-ledger credits and future completed artifacts/service
symbolic_asset_functions.additive_rule: micro-ledger memorandum until a source explicitly reconciles it into the trillion-scale headline

symbolic_asset_functions.amount_relation: can map to one growth or repair event when a real before→after transition is documented
symbolic_asset_functions.additive_rule: no credit for merely clicking/claiming passage

symbolic_asset_functions.amount_relation: can map to one completed yield/growth/repair event per non-duplicative arc
symbolic_asset_functions.additive_rule: do not pay every symbolic step; reward sourced completion/output

assets.treatment: primary treasury asset / reciprocal claim reserve
memorandum subset of the larger claim field; do not add to 42T unless future reconciliation proves it is outside the headline
witness/archive/moderation/building labor; converts to positive value only through sourced outputs or a future bounded pricing contract

liabilities.treatment: amount the symbolic Bank credits to account holders; bank-side liability / customer-side asset

liabilities.caveat: Actual recognized accrual depends on exact story-entry dates; provisional accounts are not forced into day-level precision.

liabilities.treatment: unresolved account identities remain in suspense until resolved, merged or retired

owner_equity.label: North Root / Tim treasury capital
owner_equity.formula: headline claim reserve − recognized customer/account liabilities; micro receivables are memorandum unless proven outside the headline
owner_equity.note: Because the account-holder micro-ledger is tiny relative to 42T, owner-equity presentation remains approximately the 42T headline. Do not manufacture extra precision by subtracting unpriced unknowns.

micro_ledger_snapshot.interpretation: The priced dossier ledger is a microscopic reconciliation layer, not the mathematical source of the 42T headline. Its purpose is evidence allocation, not reverse-engineering trillions from a few people.

positive_event_calibration.principle: Use the existing event weights to price observable constructive outputs. Do not invent trillion-scale multipliers.

mappings.gate: substantial finished useful artifact/service/repair with source
documented new capability, learning milestone, cultivation or meaningful growth
one documented before→after transition; choose one category, never both for the same change
credit the completed arc/output, not each symbolic rung
only when study produces applied understanding, synthesis or capability; passive reading is zero
observable change in responsibility, repair, boundaries, understanding or generativity
completed source-preservation, protection, substantial archive/building output; scale determines one category

anti_double_count: One output receives one positive category even if it simultaneously looks like Potato growth, Table value and Ladder progress.
Do not pay for page views, declarations, role labels, repeated symbolic gestures or raw hours by themselves.
Hours are memorandum labor units until tied to outputs/results.
A positive event can coexist with an unresolved debit; accounts may be mixed.

scenario_tools.purpose: Let the Bank become richer without pretending uncertain quantities are known.
permitted: show hypothetical attribution scenarios with all assumptions visible
prohibited: multiplying people by an arbitrary average debt to force the total
counting Mountain + Potato + Spiral as separate additive 42T assets
pricing anonymous orphans without event evidence

boundaries: The 42T figure is a Tim/project symbolic headline, not independently measured wealth, legal damages or collectable currency.
The capital bridge explains the internal chronology of the project claim; it does not prove a supernatural financial system.
Mountain/Potato/Spiral/Table/Gate/Ladder are accounting metaphors/functions inside the project.
Real-world work, hours, artifacts and interactions can be measured separately from the symbolic valuation.
